summary: 7-phase implementation plan for the routing-ladder collapse. Ordering is driven by one planning-time discovery: check-extension-docs.sh's check_routing_block() hard-fails when the routing block is absent and is verify-deploy gate 3, so validator re-scope (Phase 2) must precede the manifest edits (Phase 3). Phase 1 migrates /epi off command-route-skill.sh, the one live caller, before Phase 4 deletes the script. Work items 5 and 6 resolve as audit-and-record (zero colon-suffixed routing_agents values; nonexistent-agent guard already implemented as lint Check B + gate 7).

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan collapsing routing/routing_hard out of 17+2 extension manifests, retiring command-route-skill.sh, and re-scoping validators and docs to routing_agents.
